prerequisites: Material knowledge and Technology of Materials

learning_outcomes.text: To teach the basics of the theory of machine elements with general preordination and methods for their calculation and construction.

syllabus_topics: Bulk and surface strength of machine elements
Elements of rotary motion: axis and shafts
Elements of rotary motion: automated non-automated and automatic couplings

assessment_methods.method: Current controls (two control assignments and control tests from laboratory classes)
Presentation of course assignments (screw projecting and frictional coupling)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is formed on the basis of the results of current controls and the presentation of course assignments. The type of exam is written.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
